messages:
Jordan: Heads-up — did the entitlement sweep yesterday remove the svc-admin role from payments-prod? Seeing failures in reconciliation jobs after the KMS binding change. @Sam can you confirm?
Sam: Yep I saw alerts. Reconciliation cron is failing with permission denied when trying to decrypt payloads. Error snippet: 
```
ERROR: KMS AccessDenied: projects/rdw-prod/locations/global/keyRings/payments/cryptoKeys/recon-key: caller does not have cryptoKeyDecrypter role
```
Sam: I think the sweep removed a group binding that granted the svc-deployers group access to that key.
Maria: Oh — we scoped a few admin roles last night as part of the least-priv audit. We did mark payments-prod as "high risk" but I thought we created explicit KMS exceptions. Looks like that exception didn't land.
Lina: I'm on it. Paging logs show a bulk RBAC patch at 02:12 UTC from the entitlement-sweeper job: patch id eq-2026-03-04T02:12.
DevOpsBot: Incident created: INC-2026-0324-88 — "payments-recon KMS decrypt failures" — page sent to #eng-oncall.
Jordan: For immediate mitigation can we re-add the cryptoKeyDecrypter grant to the recon service account and then run a dry decrypt? Sam, do you have the service account id?
Sam: recon-sa@redwood-prod. Quick regrant command (gcloud):
```
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding recon-key \
  --location global --keyring payments \
  --member serviceAccount:recon-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
```
Lina: I'll run that now in staging first, then prod after thumbs-up.
Maria: Also need a postmortem for the sweep logic — it shouldn't remove KMS grants that are flagged as "service-critical". Whoever owns the sweep config, please add gate checks. @Jordan assigning to you for config follow-up?
Jordan: I'll take ownership. Action items: 1) Lina regrant in prod and validate (in 15m). 2) Sam run recon dry-run and paste logs here. 3) Maria update sweep rules to honor service-critical KMS exceptions. 4) Create a short runbook step to rollback KMS bindings if decrypt errors spike.
Sam: Dry-run log after grant: 
```
2026-03-24T02:30:15Z recon: decrypt OK for 1024 msgs
```
Sam: No more failures in the last 10m. Jobs resumed. :thumbsup:
Lina: Regrant completed in prod at 02:31 UTC. Posted audit entry: grant-by-lina manual-fix.
Maria: Thanks. For longer-term: let's add a pre-sweep check that queries active service principals using the key and marks exceptions if usage in last 30d > threshold. I can prototype a query.
Jordan: Agreed. Also we should decouple entitlement-sweeper from direct IAM writes for KMS keys — make it create proposed patches and a review queue for ops for the first 2 weeks after rollout.
Lina: I'll open the PR for the quick rollback runbook and a monitoring alert that watches KMS decrypt error rate.
OncallBot: RESOLVED INC-2026-0324-88 — acknowledged by oncall at 02:35 UTC.
Jordan: Postmortem to follow. Quick note: keep the payments KMS key on the exception list until we have the sweep gating in place.
Maria: Agreed. I'll own the sweep gating PR and the acceptance tests. ETA EOD tomorrow.
Sam: Thanks all — leaving a follow-up card in the security board: SEC-3287 (entitlement-sweep: KMS safe-guarding).
Lina: :eyes: Closing thread when PRs are linked.
Jordan: Closing for now — great triage.
